headline: Netflix Seeks Growth Strategy Following Significant Stock Decline
summary: Netflix shares are down 26% in 2026, heading toward their worst yearly performance since 2022, as the company searches for new growth catalysts.
why: Netflix is a dominant global streaming media provider whose valuation is sensitive to subscriber additions and content hits.

impacts.name: Netflix
impacts.why: Slumping stock performance pressures management to deliver major streaming hits.
